Hi readers!
My name is Clarissa, I am originally from Indonesia and came to Vancouver in 2019 to do my Bachelor's degree in Mathematics at UBC.
After graduating in 2023, I worked as a Data Analyst and Developer at DarkVision Technologies for 3 years.
I am now returning to UBC to join the Master's of Data Science program (2026-2027), hoping to enhance my hard skills in data science and
analysis to be more confident when returning to data-related roles.
